note: The freedom window («ВОЛЯ.narod»): a home-made 2000s fan site. The tiled peace-and-leaf background over the whole screen (560-unit squares of the baked 140-unit tile, laid edge to edge from the stage's corner), and on the 1600x900 stage: the WordArt banner, the running line, the menu box (branches as links, the pool on LED counters, 'Сторінка в розробці!'), the helper leaf with its speech bubble, the tree growing up in a ridge frame, the node window info.exe, and the visitor-counter footer. Roles the menu fills are in source/ui/SKINS.md; the skin class drives the rest (OZL_TreeSkin_Freedom). Numbers are the mockup's, measured in Chrome.

raw.name: SiteTiles
raw.note: The stage's twin that does not clip: 7 x 3 squares of the tile from (-1120, -560) cover any screen up to 32:9, keeping the mockup's tile phase on the stage.

panel.name: Banner
panel.note: The banner (.fbanner): the spinning peace sign, the rainbow WordArt title of the player's language and the leaf, centred together (the skin places the two symbols by the title's width, OnShow), and the dev line bottom right.

icon.name: WordArt
icon.note: WordArt sprite (660x80 + pad 20): the skin loads STR_OZL_SKIN_FREEDOM_WORDART_IMG into it.

icon.name: Peace
icon.note: Sixteen frames peace_00..15, swapped by the skin (6 s a turn).

label.name: DevName
label.note: Times italic 16 in the mockup: PT Serif SDF, the skin asks for italics (SetItalic).

frame.name: Marquee
frame.note: The running line (.marquee): black with magenta rules; the skin moves MarqueeText from the right edge until it has left on the left, 26 s a pass. The frame clips it.

label.name: MarqueeText
label.note: Bold Times 18 in the mockup: PT Serif SDF + SetBold. Wider than the line on purpose: a label clips its text at its box.

panel.name: LeftBox
panel.note: The menu box (.fbox): 5-unit ridge frame over black .72; ':: МЕНЮ ::' bar, the branches as links, ':: БАЛИ ::' bar and the pool (this section follows the branch list: the skin moves it, OnPaint), the hazard sign at the bottom.

list.name: BranchScroll
list.note: The menu creates a row per branch in BranchList (ozl_freedom_branch_row); the skin sizes this list to its rows (OnPaint), so it never shows a bar. A list like the card's and the pool's on the 16:14 stand: a bare WrapSpacer in a panel showed no row there. It also declares the pool row (PoolScroll is a raw scroll for its tinted bar; both are 308 wide, so the pool row is still laid out against 298).

row.name: OZL_FreedomBranchRow
row.note: A branch as a link of the menu (.branch): yellow '»', the name underlined in link blue (pink for the open branch), and '← ти тут' after the open one (RowPick, shown by the menu); the count right-aligned. RowHit is the click (the menu renames it branch:<id>). The skin lines the three parts up by their texts (FlowLater on RowFlow) and colours the open one (OnPaint).

row.name: OZL_FreedomPoolRow
row.note: One line of the pool (.prow): the round chip of the line, its name (faint when the faction has none), and the number as the mockup's LED counter -- a black inset box with up to six bold red monospace digits (PT Mono SDF + SetBold, the mockup's bold Courier), one per slot, right-aligned 13.8 apart like its letter-spaced text, glowing (an SDF text shadow); a zero is dark red without the glow. The skin fills the slots (PaintPoolRow).

raw.name: PoolScroll
raw.note: One row per line of points, 36 apart; more lines than fit scroll (seven point types overflow the 250 units), the bar Windows-98 grey like the tree's and the card's. Raw with a stack (bandit's PoolScroll): a generated list takes no colour. The row template is declared on BranchScroll.

label.name: UcText
label.note: Bold Comic 15 in the mockup: Pangolin SDF + SetBold.

panel.name: TreeBox
panel.note: The tree (.tree): ridge frame over dark green .82; the star sky is drawn on the canvas by the skin (GridLine); the head shade with the branch name in pink Impact (+ its black shadow) and the sub line; the legend strip below.

raw.name: TreeScroll
raw.note: The tree: drag it, or the wheel. The menu sizes TreeContent; the tree grows up, so home is the bottom. Bars Windows-98 grey (color + style blank: thumb #c0c0c0, track half of it).

raw.name: TreeLines
raw.note: The star sky (the skin's GridLine) and every link, drawn by the menu.

icon.name: TreeFogEdge
icon.note: Clear at the bottom, solid at the top: the tree grows up.

label.name: TreeTipText
label.note: Wider than any tip: the menu sizes TreeTip from the text and TreeTip clips the rest.

icon.name: TreeHead
icon.note: The head shade (.thead: #020602 to 60 %, then clear).

label.name: BranchNameShadow
label.note: The hard shadow of the branch name (text-shadow 3px 3px 0 #000); the skin copies the name (OnPaint).

label.name: BranchName
label.note: Oswald 600 SDF: the mockup's magenta glow (0 0 8px #ff00ff) is its text shadow (OnShow).

panel.name: LegendRow
panel.note: Lined up by the menu (FlowLater from the skin's OnShow) by the width of each item's text plus 14.

list.name: TreeTemplates
list.note: Holds no rows: it only declares the row files the menu creates outside the lists.

row.name: OZL_FreedomTierLabel
row.note: A tier label (.tierlab: bold Verdana 13, #99ff33); the menu puts the row's corner on the label's centre.

row.name: OZL_FreedomOrLabel
row.note: The 'АБО' beside an 'any' diamond (Comic 11 in the mockup); the menu puts the row's corner on the diamond and colours the word like its line.

row.name: OZL_FreedomPriceChip
row.note: One line of a node's price (.price b): a 7-unit square in the line's colour, then the amount. The menu lines them up in NodePrice, 6 apart.

row.name: OZL_FreedomCostRow
row.note: A cost line of info.exe (.crow), 5 units below the one above: the chip, the name, 'have / need' in bold (green enough, red short), and the Windows 98 inset bar whose navy dashes are revealed by CostBarFill (a clipping frame the menu widens).

row.name: OZL_FreedomOpensChip
row.note: A node this one opens: a blue underlined link (.opens a), grey for a hidden one. The menu lines the chips up 6 apart and stretches ChipHit to each; the underline (ChipUnder) is sized to the text by the skin.

panel.name: InfoWin
panel.note: The node window (.fwin 'info.exe'): Windows 98 grey with a 3-unit bevel, the blue title bar with its three buttons (the × closes the tree), and the card: name, meta, status, teal section tags, the Times description, cost rows with inset bars, the time with the segment bar, the links it opens, and the big button with the reason below.

frame.name: CardBody
frame.note: 392 wide: the card list's scrollbar (10) lies in the window's right padding.

raw.name: CardScroll
raw.note: The card, top to bottom (gaps 5 inside a group, 10 between groups, as the mockup's flex); a long card scrolls above the button, its bar Windows-98 grey. Raw with a stack (sop's pattern): a generated list takes no colour. Its rows live on TreeTemplates.

panel.name: CardNameBox
panel.note: The name (Impact 30, purple) over its pink shadow 2 units off; both word-wrapped into two lines. The skin sets the box to the lines in use (OnUpdate).

label.name: CardStatus
label.note: Bold Comic 17: Pangolin SDF + SetBold, one line 1.625 x 18 tall; the gaps round it are 0.6 and 9.15, so the word sits where the mockup's 5 / 24 / 10 put it.

stack.name: CardDesc
stack.note: Times 16 / 1.35: lines 21.6 apart, word-wrapped by the menu.

panel.name: CardSegs
panel.note: The running project (.pbar): 20 navy segments in a white inset bar, 5 units below the time.

frame.name: CardOpensList
frame.note: The menu lines the 'opens' chips up here (ozl_freedom_opens_chip) and sets the height to what they take; exact width, because the menu sizes it (SKINS.md: every widget the menu sizes is exact).

icon.name: BtnDown
icon.note: The pressed look (.go:active): shown by the skin while the button is held.

raw.name: BtnResearch
raw.note: style Empty: the face is BtnUp/BtnDown under it.

label.name: BtnResearchShadow
label.note: The embossed shadow of a disabled button (text-shadow 1px 1px 0 #fff).

label.name: BtnResearchText
label.note: Bold Comic 24: Pangolin SDF + SetBold; the menu writes ButtonText.

label.name: BtnResearchHover
label.note: Navy text under the mouse (.go:hover); the menu shows it while the button is enabled.

panel.name: Footer
panel.note: The footer (.ffoot): the visit counter, the blinking NEW, the guestbook and links (inert), the copyright line. Centred as one row by the skin from the widths of its texts (OnUpdate, once).

panel.name: HelperRoot
panel.note: The helper (.fhelp): the speech bubble (three slices: the middle stretches to the text) with the tip's title and text, the buttons 'Ага' (next tip) and 'Відчепись' (hides for 10 s), and the leaf with eyes below it. The skin lays it out from the wrapped lines, bobs and blinks the leaf and fades the whole helper (OnUpdate).

icon.name: HelperLeaf
icon.note: Frames leaf_open / leaf_half / leaf_shut (the blink), moved up and down by the skin (the bob).
